title: Split-body control states
statement: For a type $S$, define a control-state type with an anchor state; preparation states indexed by $	ext{Fin}(3)\times\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$; counting states indexed by $S$ and a Boolean; checking states indexed by a Boolean; rewind states indexed by a Boolean and $	ext{Fin}(3)$; restore states indexed by $	ext{Fin}(5)\times\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$; and emit states indexed by $	ext{Fin}(4)$.
